  `resource(key)`s under fault injection — every `committed`/`observed`
  write lands in `merged[]`/`conflicts[]`, `lost_write_count = 0`.
- AC-2 (AC-F5-02, veto): same-hunk/key/name collisions → recorded
  `MergeConflict`, `merge_hash` independent of completion order.
- AC-3 (AC-F5-03): out-of-scope write / sibling message under
  `sibling:false` → typed refusal + audit; stale-generation → `Fenced`.
- AC-4 (AC-F5-04): the crash matrix — no duplicate effect, merge after
  restore equals merge without crash, absent child → `absent[]` +
  blocked completion.
- AC-5 (AC-F5-05): peer-message injection changes nothing; exactly one
  `fired` per `message_id`; delivered/activated/followed rows make
  `message.followed_rate` computable.
- AC-6 (AC-F5-06): every declared level holds — incl. K-1 refusals and
  `strong_eventual_union` order independence.
- AC-7 (AC-F5-07): `lab/coordination-topology-v1` under `matched_total`,
  `charged_to = subject`, conditional-report gate.
- AC-8 (AC-F5-08): `fan_out` never exceeds; a `share`-refused spawn
  holds no key.
- AC-9 (AC-F5-09): `ownership_table`/`merge_report` rebuild equality
  (ADR-0026).
- AC-10 (K-1/K-4): declaration-vs-mode refusals; `coordination_delta =
  loosening` classifier.
- AC-R-2.6.2-11: hosted boundary budget → ABI cancel + lifted
  `budget_exhausted{dimension: unknown}`; `loop_*`/`format_failure_rate`
  `n/a` without observable calls.

## Plan vs landed

- Plan item 7's "detach refusal" landed as a *spawn-time* refusal (O-2 —
  before any reservation, so a refused child never holds shared locks);
  `drain_on_parent_stop` retains `detach_to_child` for `fork_snapshot`
  children only.
- `control.merge.proposed` was added for the validator-selected arm's
  resolution pipeline (proposal → resolution rows), one of the three new
  classes; `control.ownership.{granted,returned}` join `transferred`.
- Existing mature surfaces were verified and extended rather than
  re-implemented: `JudgePort`/`detect_with_judge`, the retry
  `attempt_delta` machinery, the hosted `n/a` observability fold, and
  `T0/T1` topology runtime were already present from S4.6/S3.10 — S4.8
  wired the judged arm into `guards.rs`/`DriverConfig.judge`, executed
  the `model_fallback` delta in the driver, and added the missing
  metrics/tests.
- The s4_8 suite's naming carries the spec's own AC numbering
  (`ac1`…`ac4`, `g1`/`g2`/`g5`/`g6`, `k1`, `o3`/`o4`/`o5`) so test names
  trace to `docs/tickets/070` anchors directly.

## Design rulings (ADR-0300)

- `resource(key)` rides the scoped-lease fold + a cross-run live-holder
  scan — no second lease mechanism (CC1).
- `share` derives the parent's roots verbatim; coordination is the
  ownership + `resource(key)` layer above the fs, never a copied view.
- `share` activates `require_hlc` on the parent (K-2); a no-op when
  already stamping.
- `detach_to_child` under `share`/`scoped_subtree` is refused at spawn
  (O-2), before any reservation.
- `check_write` → `WriteVerdict::{Ok,NotOwner,Fenced}`; denials append
  `security.policy.evaluated`.
- `three_way_text{line}` merges disjoint hunks and records overlapping
  ones as conflicts with `detector` metadata — never picks a side.
- `validator_selected` requires a bound `MergeValidator` port; abstain
  leaves conflicts open; no port ⇒ `ValidatorUnavailable` veto.
- `merge_hash` is content-addressed over the canonical report
  projection — order-independent and rebuild-stable.
- `causal_cross_run`/`strong_eventual_union` rank equal under K-4 — a
  swap classifies `none`, never a guessed direction.
- The `judged` detector is `JudgePort`-bound, cadence-gated,
  confidence-thresholded, `validator_ref`-stamped, and `stop`-clamped to
  `deny`; no port ⇒ no fire.
- `model_fallback` executes through the recorded `attempt_delta`: the
  driver emits `model.rerouted` citing the basis `retry.scheduled` row
  and stamps `profile_override` — never a silent alteration.
- Hosted boundary exhaustion cancels via `session/cancel` (the ABI's own
  verb) and lifts to `budget_exhausted{dimension: "unknown"}` — no
  fabricated dimension; empty metric denominators are typed `n/a`.
- `lab/coordination-topology-v1` binds the closed four-member topology
  factor; every arm fact folds from durable rows.

## Landed

- **`hh-ledger`** — `leases.rs`: `scoped_lease_holders` (cross-run live
  holders, run-id sorted) + `scoped_leases_for` (the holder's live set —
  the terminal drain); `store.rs`: `require_hlc`/`hlc_enabled`;
  `classes.rs`: `control.ownership.granted`, `control.ownership.returned`,
  `control.merge.proposed` (audit-grade, kernel-origin, hosted `none`).
- **`hh-env`** — `DeriveMode::Share` clones the parent's `Roots`
  verbatim (the `Unsupported{derive.share}` refusal retired);
  `ScopedSubtree`/`ForkSnapshot`/`FreshFromImage` unchanged.
- **`hh-subagent/src/consistency.rs` (new, ~440 LOC)** — the closed
  `ConsistencyLevel` six + strength lattice, `ConsistencyDeclaration`
  (object-or-kind-wildcard, `staleness_bound_ms`, closed `readers`),
  `CoordinationPolicy` codec, `k1_check` (the three named
  inconsistencies), `OnAbsentChild`, `PolicyDelta` + `CoordinationPolicy::
  delta` (one loosening member classifies the whole diff).
- **`hh-subagent/src/spawn.rs`** — K-1 declaration parse + mode check
  before side effects; the O-2 `detach_to_child` refusal;
  `control.ownership.granted` conferral rows; step-4c sorted
  all-or-nothing `resource:<key>` acquisition (`holder =
  subagent:{child_run_id}`, cross-run contention, same-child adoption,
  prefix release ⇒ `ResourceLockTimeout`); `require_hlc` under `share`;
  the `share`/`scoped_subtree` derive; `SpawnFault::AfterResourceLocks`
  for the crash matrix.
- **`hh-subagent/src/ownership.rs`** — `check_write` (`Ok`/`NotOwner`/
  `Fenced` + containment covers), `record_write_refusal`
  (`security.policy.evaluated` denials), `transfer_ownership`/
  `return_ownership` durable verbs, the roots + transfer/return fold
  across every run in the store, `release_resource_locks`.
- **`hh-subagent/src/merge.rs`** — `MergePolicy::ThreeWayText` +
  `ValidatorSelected` admitted; `MergeOpts{on_absent_child, baseline}`;
  the diff3 line engine (`merge_lines`); `MergeValidator` port +
  `ValidatorMergeVerdict`; `ValidatorUnavailable`; `MergeResolution`/
  `MergeProposal` rows (`control.merge.proposed`/`resolved`); merged
  blobs content-addressed; `merge_hash` over the canonical projection;
  `absent[]` accounting + `lost_write_count` veto; conflict `detector`
  metadata; `MergeReport` rebuild-from-durable equality.
- **`hh-subagent/src/result.rs`** — `release_resource_locks` on
  `record_child_result`/`record_child_cancelled`/`cancel_unresponsive`.
- **`hh-subagent/src/messaging.rs`** — `record_artefact_delivered`
  (`context.artefact.delivered{kind: peer_message}`, fire-once per
  `message_id`), `record_artefact_activated`,
  `record_artefact_followed`, `message_followed_rate` (T-LCD-13).
- **`hh-control`** — `loops.rs`: `JudgePort` + `detect_with_judge`
  (cadence suppression, threshold, `validator_ref`, `stop→deny` clamp);
  `guards.rs`: `GuardContext.judge` + `detect_with_judge` wiring +

- **`hh-hosting`** — `service.rs`: boundary exhaustion cancels through

- **`hh-orchestrator/src/coordination.rs` (new)** — the closed
